strengths.point: Net profit is growing fast year on year.
The reserves trend has been rising for 5 years in a row.
Operating profit is converting into cash almost one for one.
Return on capital has improved over recent years.

strengths.point: Relative strength is in the top tier of the market.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Operating margin has compressed over the last few years.

weaknesses.evidence: Operating profit 9.76 Cr vs interest 3.85 Cr = 2.54x cover (TTM)

weaknesses.point: Inventory tie up a lot of cash.

Cash stays locked in the working-capital cycle for a long time.

weaknesses.evidence: Flagged as a negative: Working capital days have increased from 174 days to 281 days

weaknesses.point: Earnings follow a seasonal cycle rather than a steady line.
weaknesses.evidence: CYCLICAL - strong: Mar, Sep; weak: Jun, Dec

opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.

opportunities.point: The real estate project is completed and all villas and apartments have been sold.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Our project is completed and sold all villas and apartments have been sold." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company is replacing old machinery in the Nagari unit with modernized machinery in a phased manner.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Our company is replacing its old machineries used in Nagari unit with all modernized machineries in a phased manner." (annual report - 2023-03-31)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
A textiles tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The Indian textile industry experienced challenges in FY25 due to global trade uncertainties and price fluctuations despite domestic demand showing signs of recovery.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "In FY25, the Indian Textile Industry experienced challenges." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: Market trends indicate stable demand conditions.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Market trends indicate stable demand conditions." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: Downstream activity and garmenting are operating at reduced capacity.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Downstream activity of working and garmenting is working at reduced capacity and so spinning sector is working at reduced capacity with yarn exports also down by 30% putting a lot of pressure on yarn prices." (annual report - 2023-03-31)

opportunities.point: Sri. P. Muthusamy is re-appointed as Director - Operations for a period of three years with effect from 27.09.2025.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Sri.P.Muthusamy (DIN : 02651331) be and is hereby re- appointed as Director – Operations for a period of three years with effect from 27.09.2025 with remuneration on the terms and conditions including as to remuneration set out in the draft agreement..." (annual report - 2025-03-31) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: The company proposed to replace existing motors with energy-efficient motors attached to various machinery.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Proposed to replace the existing motors with energy efficient motors attached to various machinery." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: High leverage magnifies any earnings or rate shock.
The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Thin interest cover leaves little headroom if earnings dip.
threats.evidence: Operating profit 9.76 Cr vs interest 3.85 Cr = 2.54x cover (TTM)

threats.point: Inventory are stretching year on year.
Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Trade challenges persist due to weak global demand.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Though supported by strong domestic demand, narrowing trade deficit and controlled inflation, the trade challenges persist due to weak global demand." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Yarn exports are down by 30%, which places pressure on yarn prices.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "with yarn exports also down by 30% putting a lot of pressure on yarn prices." (annual report - 2023-03-31)

threats.point: An 11% duty on cotton imports keeps local prices firm despite a drop in international cotton prices.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Cotton prices have come down but still above last year prices and with 11% duty on cotton imports, local prices are firm." (annual report - 2023-03-31)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
